title: E-taxi driver gets lifetime ban over alleged sexual assault of passenger in Parañaque
summary: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has imposed a lifetime ban and perpetual revocation of the driver’s license of an e-taxi driver involved in the alleged sexual assault of a passenger.
